beta: Penalization coefficient for the random walker motion (the greater beta, the more difficult the diffusion)
mode: Mode for solving the linear system in the random walker algorithm. Available options {‘cg’, ‘cg_j’, ‘cg_mg’, ‘bf’}

doc:
This script uses random_walker routine from skimage.
Available in 2D and 3D.

Available functions for 3D processing :
    process_volume

Modules Required : skimage, pyamg

uv pip install skimage pyamg
